design_principle: minimum sufficient evidence; every new experiment must map to a claim/objection, be falsification-capable, use a matched estimand, and use the minimum sufficient prospectively calibrated cost

mandatory.name: historical first-action provenance replay
mandatory.objection: the first-action result is currently bound at claim-audit level to a summary artifact; same-condition replication must not be built on unreplayable provenance

mandatory.name: evaluation-surface baseline package
mandatory.purpose: directly test observational aliasing/evaluation coarsening rather than rank unrelated memory algorithms

mandatory.name: first-action same-condition stochasticity audit
mandatory.endpoint: unbiased exact-match-kernel MMD2/collision U-statistic on replay-qualified normalized first structured actions
mandatory.historical_tv_role: frozen original result reported alongside new audit; not retroactively replaced

sample_size.selection: smallest n with prospectively declared acceptable false-positive control and useful sensitivity under replay-qualified historical-support plus synthetic stress calibration

inference.primary_null: within each frozen state, branch labels do not change the normalized first-action distribution beyond same-condition stochasticity
inference.test: prospectively frozen state-stratified branch-label randomization/permutation test on mean per-state unbiased MMD2

decision_rules.supported_positive_branch_sensitivity: revise stage signature; do not retain strict pre-action attenuation wording; move remaining attenuation question downstream
decision_rules.not_supported_beyond_same_condition_vari: retain first-action uptake as first unsupported measured stage, without zero/equivalence claim
decision_rules.heterogeneous: report preregistered heterogeneity descriptively; no post-hoc positive-subgroup rescue

mandatory.name: figure claim audit and independent submission review
mandatory.purpose: decide whether any remaining experiment is actually verdict-changing before broader execution

conditional.name: complete Reddit E/U full-chain instrumentation
conditional.precondition: zero-provider feasibility on existing Reddit substrate
conditional.trigger: post-M2 independent submission review identifies cross-domain stage-boundary replication as verdict-changing
conditional.priority: extend existing Reddit before creating a third domain
conditional.forbidden: force a third benchmark only to increase workload

conditional.name: one additional frozen executor/backbone
conditional.trigger: post-M2 independent review identifies model/configuration specificity as verdict-changing
conditional.purpose: portability of measurement signature, not leaderboard breadth

baseline_policy.reason: their primary estimand is method performance/retrieval/arbitration, not identification of where a fixed branch-conditioned state contrast loses measured support

external_baselines_after_genuine_p0_pass: one fair decision-time memory arbitration baseline such as MemArbiter-like
optional distinct state-aware relevance/retrieval baseline such as SAMem-like

explicitly_rejected_workload_inflation: add 3+ models because SkillZip Pro used multiple models
add 3+ benchmarks because a systems paper used multiple workloads
run unrelated memory algorithms with mismatched estimands
run terminal trajectories for a first-action-only question
create a third domain before evaluating whether existing Reddit can close E/U
top up sample size after inspecting M2 effects
select positive state subgroups post hoc
use PACTA execution as rescue for the measurement paper
